scenarios.title: An aftermath half can be cast only from a graveyard

setup.notes: Cut is the first half of the split card Cut // Ribbons; Ribbons is the aftermath half.

decisions: A casts Ribbons with X=2, tapping four Swamps for {2}{B}{B}.

variants.label: from_graveyard
variants.expected: Casting Ribbons from A's graveyard is legal. Ribbons resolves and B loses 2 life (18).

variants.label: from_hand
variants.delta: The split card Cut // Ribbons is in A's hand instead of A's graveyard.
variants.expected: Ribbons can't be cast from any zone other than a graveyard, so casting it from hand is not legal. The card stays in A's hand and B's life stays 20.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge lists the split card under the name of its first half; variant from_hand moves it to A's hand.

scenarios.title: A spell cast from a graveyard with aftermath is exiled instead of going to the graveyard

setup.notes: One copy of Cut // Ribbons is in A's hand and another is in A's graveyard.

decisions: A casts Ribbons from the graveyard copy with X=2, tapping four Swamps for {2}{B}{B}.
B has priority with Ribbons on the stack and passes; A passes.

variants.label: ribbons_resolves
variants.expected: Ribbons resolves and B loses 2 life (18). The graveyard copy is exiled instead of staying in the graveyard: it is in exile and A's graveyard is empty.

variants.label: cut_from_hand
variants.delta: A casts the Cut half from the hand copy, targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping the Mountain and a Swamp, instead of casting Ribbons.
variants.expected: Cut resolves and deals 4 damage to Grizzly Bears, which is destroyed. The hand copy moves to A's graveyard, not to exile. The graveyard copy is untouched and B's life stays 20.

variants.label: ribbons_countered
variants.delta: B responds by casting Counterspell with both Islands, targeting Ribbons.
variants.expected: Ribbons is countered and does not resolve; B's life stays 20. The graveyard copy is exiled instead of staying in the graveyard: it is in exile and A's graveyard is empty.
